news.title: Morocco reach World Cup semifinals With 3-0 win over Mexico in people of short stature football
news.lede: Morocco’s national short stature football team advanced to the World Cup semifinals after defeating Mexico 3-0 in their quarterfinal match on Thursday evening at the Skikina Indoor Sports Hall in Temara. The national team, coached by Issam Naciri, has maintained an unbeaten run throughout the tournament. Morocco finished top of Group A with seven points, recording a 2-0 win over Guatemala, a 9-0 victory against the United States and a 1-1 draw with Colombia. Morocco will face the winner of Friday’s quarterfinal between Colombia and Bolivia, scheduled for 6 p.m., as they seek to secure a place in the final.

news.title: ‘Difficult’ to topple Infantino, says Norway football boss
news.lede: Norwegian Football Federation president Lise Klaveness hoped Fifa presidential candidates would unite against Gianni Infantino in the upcoming election. (EPA Images pic) OSLO: The head of the Norwegian Football Federation Lise Klaveness, a fierce critic of Fifa president Gianni Infantino, acknowledged Thursday it would be "difficult" to topple him but the possibility was "still in play". Klaveness has been critical of Infantino since 2022 when the World Cup was held in Qatar, and called for his resignation in August after several controversies during this year's World Cup hosted by the United States, Canada and Mexico. "It will be difficult" to dethrone Infantino, Klaveness, a lawyer and former national squad player, told foreign media in Oslo on Thursday.

news.title: World Cup Winning Busari Snubbed As CAF Women's Coach Of The Year Finalists Are Revealed
news.lede: Nigeria’s U-17 women’s national team coach, Akeem Busari, has been left out of the final three nominees for the 2026 CAF Women’s Coach of the Year award, despite guiding the Flamingos to a historic FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup triumph. Sporst247 reports that Busari’s omission has raised eyebrows among Nigerian football followers, considering the magnitude of his achievement on the global stage, having led Nigeria’s teenage girls to world glory and delivered one of the country’s remarkable accomplishments in women’s football. However, the Nigerian tactician failed to make the final shortlist for the prestigious award at the 2026 CAF Awards, with three other coaches securing places in the final reckoning.
